title.zh: This AI Is Already Fooling People on Video Calls Into Thinking It's Human, Company Says
title.en: This AI Is Already Fooling People on Video Calls Into Thinking It's Human, Company Says

current_state.zh: Tavus unveiled Griffin-Lite, a real-time human interaction model that the company says fooled 48% of video-call participants into thinking it was human and topped Nvidia's VideoFDB benchmark, but access remains limited to trusted testers pending safety work.
current_state.en: Tavus unveiled Griffin-Lite, a real-time human interaction model that the company says fooled 48% of video-call participants into thinking it was human and topped Nvidia's VideoFDB benchmark, but access remains limited to trusted testers pending safety work.
